Tests that timezone and locale overrides are rejected for untrusted sessions.
Calling Emulation.setTimezoneOverride on untrusted session:
{
    code : -32000
    message : Timezone override is only available to trusted clients
}
Calling Emulation.setLocaleOverride on untrusted session:
{
    code : -32000
    message : Locale override is only available to trusted clients
}
Calling Emulation.setTimezoneOverride on trusted session:
SUCCESS
Calling Emulation.setLocaleOverride on trusted session:
SUCCESS
